01 / VERIFY FIRST
Python 3.10+, Node 22+. No package dependencies, accounts or payments for offline checks. Download and extract the source kit. Run commands in a terminal.
[ GITHUB SOURCE ][ SOURCE ZIP ]
unzip battery-pilot-kit.zip -d battery-kit
cd battery-kit
python3 -m unittest -v test_battery.py test_live_agent.py
python3 verify_evidence.py
node --test devnet/anchor.test.mjs
cd site
node --test test-network.mjs
20 Python tests check policy, failure, receipt recovery and unknown outcomes. Ten Node tests check memo/API boundaries; eight price/chain/outbox checks require the optional chain dependencies. Evidence verification checks saved hash/event relationships, not model attestation.
02 / RUN REAL INFERENCE
Install/start Ollama. Both approved models need sufficient memory and several GB of disk. They run locally without a paid provider key.
ollama pull qwen2.5:7b
ollama pull llama3.2:3b
# From repo root; start Ollama first.
python3 run_recovery.py --state-dir live-state/my-first-proof
python3 verify_evidence.py live-state/my-first-proof/live-agent.json
The controller runs three devnet briefs, forces exit 73 after the second durable receipt, starts Llama, verifies inherited state and writes live-agent.json. Use a fresh state directory; it refuses to overwrite a ledger.
If dispatch reached the model without a durable receipt, recovery stops with an unknown outcome. Do not delete state and silently repeat that task. The demonstrated boundary is after receipt commit.

03 / ADAPTER CONTRACT
  1. Configure floor, daily cap and per-job ceiling in integer microUSD.
  2. Reserve a worst-case quote against both reserve and trusted provider headroom. Approve each route before dispatch.
  3. Mark dispatch before the external effect. Persist actual receipt and result durably.
  4. Reconcile incurred cost, including charged failures. Overcharges are booked and halt new work.
  5. Take over the same ledger with a new epoch. Reconcile saved receipts; hold unknown outcomes. Export confirmed results.
core.py: configure, credit_paper, takeover, reserve, dispatch, settle, checkpoint. live_agent.py is the working Ollama example. Keep credentials outside task/checkpoint JSON.

04 / LIVE PUBLIC API
GET https://usebattery.xyz/api/network
No key, body or query parameters. Returns genesis, finalized slot/epoch/block height and recent performance sample with UNIX observedAt. Sample slot may precede the observation. Cache up to 30s; public RPC may fail.
405 for writes, 400 for parameters, 502 for invalid/unavailable upstream. Errors contain no synthetic numbers. This API cannot sign, spend or trigger model inference.
[ LIVE CONSOLE ][ OPENAPI ]
05 / OPTIONAL SIGNED CHECKPOINT
node devnet/anchor.mjs anchor live-state/my-first-proof/live-agent.json devnet-state/my-first-proof --airdrop
node devnet/anchor.mjs verify devnet-state/my-first-proof/anchor.json
Test network only, fresh local test key, exact devnet genesis. Protects 0.5 test SOL, max fee 10,000 lamports, daily fees 30,000. Quote before signing; persist bytes before sending; retry the same signature only. Expiry requires inspection, not automatic re-signing.
Faucet refused this run, so no signature is claimed. A Memo would bind a hash to a devnet slot, not prove model truth, deploy custody or fund paid inference. Private keys never enter the public kit or Vercel.
06 / GUARANTEE BOUNDARY
Trusted local operator, one SQLite ledger. Quote/time/provider headroom are trusted inputs. No authenticated paid billing, distributed lease, arbitrary framework/browser migration, hosted customer agent or USDC custody.
Copying a checkpoint does not transfer authority. Unknown effects stay held; stronger guarantees need provider idempotency/authenticated receipts. No token or contract address exists.
Browser lab: one illustrative task/hour, $30 daily cap, $500 alternate allowance, cheaper route at 40% cost, assumed fees $2/hour. Not a prediction. The 72 logical-hour replay is simulated; the hourly observer had gaps.

07 / YOUR DATA
Policies/test history use browser local storage, separate per domain. No account/cloud sync. Export before clearing data/moving devices. Imports validate and merge IDs, retain existing records: max 100 policies, 200 tests, 250 KB.
Scenario links expose parameters in the fragment, not names/history. Keep secrets out. AI ledgers stay local; published proof contains selected observations, outputs and events. The public API reads devnet on the server; hosting may process ordinary request metadata.
